name: Nikita Krylov
summary: Long-time light heavyweight veteran (31-12, 12-10 UFC), big and well rounded, with heavy hands and a strong top/submission game. Has gone 1-3 since 2025: KO'd in R1 by Reyes and Guskov, beat Modestas Bukauskas with a KO at 4:57 of R3, then was stopped by Robert Whittaker in R3. Now in his mid-30s and stopped in three of his last four fights.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive and powerful, throws long kicks and overhands; the Bukauskas KO came from a counter overhand right as Bukauskas pushed late. Defense breaks down in exchanges against sharper boxers.
how_they_fight.Grappling: His best route: big, strong wrestler with good top control and 16 career submission wins (14 in R1). Took Whittaker down 3 times early and has controlled the likes of Johnny Walker and Volkan Oezdemir (7 of 20 takedowns and over 9 minutes of control vs Oezdemir).
how_they_fight.Defense: Chin and composure are the issues: 10 career stoppage losses, incl. Reyes (R1), Guskov (R1) and Whittaker (R3, turned away holding his jaw). Has been submitted 6 times, mostly early in his career.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Historically a first-round finisher (23 of his 29 stoppage wins came in R1, 5 in R2, 1 in R3). In the UFC lately the early phase is where he is most effective (had early success vs Whittaker), and he can still land a late bomb (Bukauskas R3). Losses: 7 in R1, 1 in R2, 2 in R3 (Palelei, Whittaker), 2 decisions.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced but emotional; said the Bukauskas win 'lifted' a depression after two KO losses, and that he changed team, academy and head coach (per MMA Junkie via Yahoo). Can make reckless exchanges when behind.

patterns: Early takedowns and top pressure; R1 submissions historically
Late power punch even when tired (Bukauskas at 4:57 of R3)
Breaks under clean, accurate boxing (Reyes, Guskov, Whittaker)
Stopped in 3 of his last 4 fights
concerns: Durability: KO'd in R1 twice in 2025 and in R3 by Whittaker (jaw) in July 2026
Mid-30s and 1-3 since 2025, fell out of the rankings (per LowKick)
Facing a younger, explosive finisher who wins in R1
keys_to_beat: Land clean, straight punches in exchanges
Stuff or scramble out of early takedowns
Pressure him: he has been stopped by forward boxers

news.text: Stopped by Robert Whittaker at 1:01 of R3 at UFC 329 after a right hand; turned away holding his jaw (per Sherdog). No confirmed diagnosis.
After beating Bukauskas, said the win lifted his depression and that he had changed team, academy and head coach after his 2025 losses (MMA Junkie via Yahoo).
